fundamental.summary: KHC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 75 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional (junior member, small amounts); market fear (42 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (230), NFP event today creates immediate volatility risk, and earnings in 75 days add binary event exposure; Consumer Staples defensive positioning offers limited protection in this environment.
